Questions raised repeatedly on call: 'How different is Llama2-13B vs Mistral-medium in real prompts we care about?', 'Can we get similar answer quality with a cheaper model and prompt engineering?', 'What are token cost implications for 1k DAUs with ~200 tokens/session?'
